name: fuse-undo-button
title: Fuse Undo Button
author: henriquegpb <https://github.com/henriquegpb>
description: An archive button that turns into Undo and lights an orange fuse around its outline; the fuse holds still while you hover it, so the chance to undo only runs out once you look away.
docs: Live preview and the CSS, JavaScript and Tailwind variants: https://microkit.co/components/fuse-undo-button
